acceptanceCriteria: dogfood finish reports the bounded aggregate refusal detail (or names where it is retained) for too-many-obligations without unbounded output.
A focused test fails on the bare-code behavior and passes after.
body: Found during V1-0522 (2026-10-09, lane head 99805b0d on base 02e84575). V1-0522 made the too-many-obligations refusal name the total, the scope count, the bound 256 and each scope's count, and dogfood-change prints a fix hint. corvint dogfood finish (internal/localcompletion/finish.go:160) reduces aggregate refusals to the bare code, so an agent finishing a session sees no counts or remedy. Expected: finish keeps the bounded detail message (or a pointer to it). Actual: only the code. Status: observed by source reading in the V1-0522 lane; not reproduced end-to-end.
title: dogfood finish drops the OCM aggregate refusal detail and prints only the bare code
